concerns.text: T005 requires logging 'entropy per token' per FR-015 AND that trajectory logs 'validate against contracts/training_output.schema.yaml', but that schema omits `entropy_per_token` while declaring `additionalProperties: false`. As written, T005's own verification is unsatisfiable — every log line either omits entropy (violating FR-015) or fails schema validation. The schema or the task's validation clause must be reconciled before execution.

T009 requires `final_report.json` to include 'the data-model extension fields: correlation results, runtime summary' AND to 'validate against the schema', but `analysis_results.schema.yaml` has `additionalProperties: false` and defines neither `correlation_results` nor `runtime_summary`. The verification is self-contradictory and cannot pass; either the contract must be extended or the task must drop the schema-validation claim.

T010 requires a validation script that 'checks SC-001–SC-007' and exits 0 with all SCs passing, but SC-005's threshold is the literal `[deferred]` with no numeric minimum, so the SC-005 check has no executable pass condition. T010 as specified cannot deterministically exit 0. Root cause is the spec; the task should either exclude SC-005 or the spec must supply a threshold.

T004 streams logits to `data/processed/teacher_logits_raw.jsonl` but writes the manifest to `data/teacher_logits_raw.jsonl.manifest` — two different directories for the same artifact pair — while spec FR-006/SC-006 name `data/teacher_logits_raw.jsonl` and the prior T022 rejection cited that exact path. The canonical path must be stated once and used consistently (file, manifest, and SC-006 verifier), or the rejected-T022 failure mode will recur.

T003 bundles at least four distinct deliverables (dataset fetch/filter to parquet, privileged-context split with collision handling, loader summary JSON, and an end-to-end smoke run through preprocess → one training step → one metric). This is too coarse for deterministic execution and should be atomized so each artifact (filtered parquet, context_split.jsonl, data_loader_summary.json, smoke-run result rows) has its own producer and verification.

T012's deliverable 'record the paper-stage handoff: required tables, figures, statistical fields, and the research-question conclusion' names no output file or location, and 'confirm T003–T010 checks pass deterministically' names no log or report capturing the confirmation. Add a concrete artifact (e.g. `results/repro_check.json` and a handoff doc path) so completion is verifiable.

T005's verification includes confirming '(ii) JSD increases monotonically under AntiSD' — an empirical outcome of the experiment, not an executable check the implementer controls. Rephrase as 'log the JSD-per-step series and record whether it is monotonic in `results/`' so the task is completable regardless of the scientific result; the outcome interpretation belongs to T008/T010.
